scope: Credited single-shot quantum-Tanner decoding plus explicit physical extraction/decoder accounting gives repeated protected storage under a computable constant global adversarial fraction. A deterministic five-step ejection lemma, composed with a supplied outer code, gives a clean-input ONE-WAY protected transition and an explicit polynomial-size binary-linear controller. Conditional universal-gadget invariants, a permutation-independence identity and a necessary intermediate-erasure condition retain their exact limits. The full uniform constant-fraction adversarial universal quantum-FT compiler remains OPEN, as does the separate quantum-PCP question; no general impossibility theorem is obtained.
review.source_availability: Primary single-shot Tanner decoding is credited existing machinery, not a new decoding theorem or an unsupported noisy-syndrome theorem for the different previously represented qLTC family. Storage supplies no universal protected logical gate set. Ejection begins with a CLEAN composite encoding; the full decorated input conditions cannot be replaced by raw weight for noisy intermediate input. The deterministic ejection consequence sharpens an earlier broad locally-stochastic summary of2609.39345v1, but it does not supply reverse injection, protected Bell preparation or a universal code-switching cycle against every global adversarial set. The reverse is not a deterministic channel adjoint: measured/discarded entanglement must actually be prepared. All helper space enlarges the adversary budget. Serializing work does not prove protected selected-logical measurement, non-Clifford implementation, known auxiliary preparation or recovery through growing fault-bearing depth. A physical T gate, a polynomial logical-operation circuit, bounded quantum depth or repeated vulnerable small-helper measurement is not a fault-tolerant gadget. Secret permutation support spreading requires genuine independence from the fault set, with charged fixed-wire routing and secrecy against persistent probes; neither is constructed. Intermediate-erasure necessity excludes only legally targetable exposed carriers, not every jointly encoded/private-location/other architecture. The existing universal-adversarial theorem retains its shrinking 2^-O(sqrt(log N)) fraction and classical-function qualifications. No ZIP; no individual file downloaded/previewed. New failed bodies2609.26691v3,2610.03920v1,2510.08552v1,2609.30159v2 and DOI10.1103/3fj5-gn1h remain HELD; no identifying attempt, retry or alternate recovery, and no construction imported from those unread bodies. All predecessor source/access/transfer holds remain. No Capital scientific execution, novelty audit, model/compute/private-helper inference, full compiler/threshold/95 or practical device claim. Root assessment is supplied at provisional correctness-assumed55–65. The major Tanner decoder is PRIMARY imported machinery, not a new mission decoder. Representations and compatible family lengths are supplied; actual outer-corrector execution cost C_out(k) must be charged, and a polynomial description alone is not a polynomial recovery algorithm. The same full FT successor is released but unfinished; no actual start follows just from release. Prior family90–94 is nonadditive, no95 or quantum-PCP implication.
